title: 布里茨·大手小茶杯
description: 黄铜机器人布里茨用圆大手掌托起小茶杯，身后蒸汽管冒出温和白气。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Blitzcrank is a bulky golden brass robot with an oversized barrel chest, small rounded head, glowing blue eyes, huge segmented arms, round metal fists, and short sturdy legs. Preserve the mechanical joints, shoulder plates, and little rear steam pipes while softening the silhouette into chunky crayon shapes. Both hands remain attached and relaxed, with no rocket punch or threatening pose.
art_direction.scene: He sits beside a tiny cafe table, balancing one delicate teacup on his enormous open palm while carefully bringing a little saucer closer with the other hand. A small puff of harmless steam echoes the steam from the cup. Two simple stools and a rounded window make the mechanical character feel gentle and domestic.
art_direction.palette: brass yellow, cream, sky blue glow, warm rust
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
